SELECT o.status,
  COUNT(*) AS order_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ordered_in_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatched_in_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' AND o.order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web AS (
  SELECT o.web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS order_date,
         o.line_count, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
         BOOL_OR(p.category = 'ZZ Test') AS has_test, BOOL_OR(f.staff_purchase_flag) AS has_staff,
         MIN(f.sale_date) AS min_sale_date, MAX(f.sale_date) AS max_sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) AS n_store_keys
  FROM fact_web_order o
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(net) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN n_lines <> line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linecount_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_test THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN has_staff THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_sale_date <> order_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS saledate_ne_orderdate, MAX(n_store_keys) AS max_store_keys
FROM web WHERE dispatch_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net,
         SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, s.store_id)) AS rcp_keys
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date AS sale_date, receipts, net_sales_before_returns AS net, units_sold AS units
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id < 900
)
SELECT SUM(m.receipts) AS my_receipts, SUM(m.rcp_keys) AS my_rcp_keys, SUM(c.receipts) AS ctl_receipts, SUM(m.net) AS my_net, SUM(c.net) AS ctl_net,
  SUM(m.units) AS my_units, SUM(c.units) AS ctl_units, COUNT(*) AS joined_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.receipts <> c.receipts OR m.net <> c.net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS differing_store_days,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mine) AS my_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ctl) AS ctl_rows
FROM mine m FULL OUTER JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = m.store_id AND c.sale_date = m.sale_date

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS first_period, 3 AS last_period
),
store_receipts AS (
    -- physical store receipts, dated by sale_date; staff purchases, store 999 and ZZ Test out
    SELECT f.receipt_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    GROUP BY f.receipt_id
),
web_receipts AS (
    -- web orders on the Helsinki dispatch date, not cancelled, test articles and staff purchases out
    SELECT o.web_order_id AS receipt_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
    FROM fact_web_order o
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    GROUP BY o.web_order_id
),
all_receipts AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_receipts UNION ALL SELECT * FROM web_receipts
)
SELECT params.fiscal_year, params.first_period, params.last_period,
       ROUND(SUM(net) / COUNT(*), 2) AS atv
FROM all_receipts CROSS JOIN params
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
